name: @aexhq/repository
description: Repository for the aex SDK, CLI, contracts, conformance helpers, user tests, and docs.

scripts.build: bun run --filter @aexhq/contracts build && bun run --filter @aexhq/conformance build && bun run --filter @aexhq/cli build && bun run --filter @aexhq/sdk build
scripts.lint: bun run brand:check && bun run --filter @aexhq/contracts build && bun run --filter @aexhq/conformance build && bun run --filter @aexhq/sdk build && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.scripts.json && bun run --workspaces --if-present --parallel lint && bun run lint:tests
scripts.test:unit: bun run --workspaces --if-present --parallel test:unit && bun run --filter @aexhq/sdk test:security && bun run vitest run --root scripts/validate capability-matrix.test.ts
scripts.pack:sdk: bun run --filter @aexhq/sdk build && bun run --filter @aexhq/sdk pack:dry-run && bun run contracts:boundary:check
